citation: Kumar KV, Kumar R, Akhtar M, Tyagi P, Madan N. Decompression sickness after exercise at 4,572 m (15,000 ft) - a case report. Aviation Medicine. 1986;30(2):92–95.
locator: Case Report and Discussion, printed pp. 92–94
note: The authors assigned Allen grade 4 bends. Sweating began on reaching ground level. The paper reports left-elbow pain after 15 minutes of descent, pain remaining on day 2 and complete resolution by day 5. Nine others reportedly completed a similar protocol without the pressure mishap and cannot supply the denominator for this accident. Clinical symptom grade is distinct from Doppler VGE grade.
